questions.q: Four friends, Priya, Kavya, Gaurvi and Shalini, have different amounts of money with them. If Priya takes ₹88 from Kavya, then she will have an amount equal to what Gaurvi has. Shalini and Kavya together have a total of ₹550. If Gaurvi takes ₹25 from Shalini, she will have an amount equal to what Kavya has. If the total amount with Shalini, Kavya and Gaurvi is ₹840, how much money does Priya have?
questions.solution:
Given:

Equation (1) → Priya takes ₹88 from Kavya, then she will have an amount equal to what Gaurvi has.

Priya + 88 = Gaurvi

Equation (2) → Shalini and Kavya together have a total of ₹550.

Shalini + Kavya = 550

Equation (3) → If Gaurvi takes ₹25 from Shalini, she will have an amount equal to what Kavya has.

Gaurvi + 25 = Kavya

Equation (4) → Total amount with Shalini, Kavya and Gaurvi is ₹840.

Shalini + Kavya + Gaurvi = 840

From equation (4) and (2)

Gaurvi + 550 = 840

Gaurvi = 840 – 550 = 290

From equation (1) → Priya + 88 = Gaurvi

So, Priya + 88 = 290

Priya = 290 – 88 = 202

Hence, Priya have ‘202’ rs.

• Examples of non-conservative forces are friction, air resistance, and tension in the cord.

The correct answer is 'the biggest enterprise' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

Key Points

• In the given sentence, the singular form of the noun ''enterprise'' is incorrect.

• The phrase ''One of'' in the given sentence is a singular term and is generally used to talk about a noun or a pronoun.
